tickerText: [TENNIS] Team Europe leads Team World 3-1 after Friday's Laver Cup openers at London's O2 as Ruud, Jódar and Alcaraz/Menšík won, Talia Gibson reached the Singapore Open final by walkover after Tatiana Prozorova withdrew under concussion protocol • [SQUASH] Anahat Singh beat Tanvi Khanna 11-2, 11-5, 11-3 in 19 minutes on Sept. 26 to reach the Asian Games women's semifinals, while Pakistan's Noor Zaman and Mohammad Ashab Irfan both advanced to the men's last four in Nagoya • [BADMINTON] Loh Kean Yew beat Lakshya Sen 21-12, 15-21, 21-14 on Sept. 26 to reach the Asian Games men's singles round of 16, and world No. 1 An Se-young opened with a 21-5, 21-5 win in 20 minutes • [PICKLEBALL] The Carvana PPA Tour's Rate Las Vegas Open runs Sept. 28-Oct. 4 with Sharp's "In the Kitchen" fan activation Oct. 1, after Haworth and Waters won at the Veolia Arizona Open • [TABLE TENNIS] Manush Shah and Diya Chitale assured India mixed doubles bronze at the Asian Games, while Yashaswini Ghorpade fell 1-4 to Japan's Miwa Harimoto in the women's singles third round on Sept. 26

newsItems.title: Gibson Into Singapore Final
newsItems.excerpt: Talia Gibson advanced to her first WTA singles final at the Singapore Open on Sept. 26 by walkover after Tatiana Prozorova withdrew following a concussion protocol dispute after being hit by a smash in doubles.

newsItems.title: Loh Beats Sen at Asiad
newsItems.excerpt: Former world champion Loh Kean Yew beat India's Lakshya Sen 21-12, 15-21, 21-14 on Sept. 26 in Nagoya to reach the Asian Games men's singles round of 16 as he chases Singapore's first badminton medal since 2006.

newsItems.title: India's Mixed Doubles Bronze
newsItems.excerpt: Manush Shah and Diya Chitale upset Hong Kong's Wong Chun Ting and Doo Hoi Kem to reach the Asian Games mixed doubles semifinals, delivering only India's fourth table tennis medal in Asian Games history.

newsItems.title: PPA Heads to Vegas
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's 1,000-point Rate Las Vegas Open opens Sept. 28 with Sharp debuting its "In the Kitchen" fan zone Oct. 1, following Championship Sunday wins for Christopher Haworth and Anna Leigh Waters in Arizona.
